SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
Austin City Council Work Session
Wednesday, April 28, 2010
The Austin City Council will convene at 9:30 AM on
Wednesday, April 28, 2010 at Austin City Hall
Boards and Commissions
301 W. Second Street, Austin, TX
Mayor Lee Leffing\\7eU
Mayor Pro Tern Mike Martinez
Council Member Chris Riley, Place 1
Council Member Randi Shade, Place 3
Council Member Laura Morrison, Place 4
Council Member William Spelman, Place 5
Council Member Sheryl Cole, Place 6
For meeting information, contact the City Clerk, 974-2210
The City Council will go into a dosed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas Government Code
to receive advice from legal counsel, to discuss matters of land acquisition, to discuss personnel matters,
to discuss or take action on a "competitive matter" of Austin Energy as provided for
under Section 551.086, or for other reasons permitted by la w as specifically listed on this agenda.
If necessary, the City Council may go into a closed session as permitted by law regarding any item on this
agenda.
Reading and Action on Consent Agenda
Action on the Following:
Ordinances / Resolutions / Motions -
All of the following items may be acted upon by one motion. No separate discussion or
action on any of the items is necessary unless desired by a Council Member.

To:
From:
Shirley Gentry, City Clerk
Mayor Lee Leffingwell U*
Date: 
April 13,2010
Subject: 
Special Called Meetings
In accordance with Article II, Section 10 of the City Charter, this will serve as my written
request for two special called meetings of the Austin City Council. The first meeting is to
be held on Wednesday, April 21, 2010, 9:30 AM, at Austin City Hall, Boards and
Commissions to conduct a presentation and discussion on the City's Economic Outlook
and Five Year Financial Forecast for the General Fund.
The second meeting is to be held Wednesday, April 28, 2010, 9:30 AM, at Austin City
Hall, Boards and Commissions to conduct a Presentation and Discussion on the City's
Financial Forecast, including presentations from Enterprise Fund Departments.
